description: Exact per-vehicle prices from the live fixed price list for private Queensland airport transfers (Gold Coast OOL, Brisbane BNE) and Brisbane Cruise Terminal runs (use "Brisbane Cruise Terminal" or "Pinkenba" as the place), including Byron Bay / Northern NSW. Supports optional return trips (trip=return + return_date/return_time); return totals use the operator native return discount. Deterministic — never estimates. If match is "none", give the customer the phone number instead of guessing.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) (optional)

dropoff.description: Alias for to (same meaning as request_booking.dropoff)

flight.description: Flight number (optional; prefills the booking form)

from.description: Pick-up place, e.g. "Broadbeach", "Byron Bay" or "OOL" (alias: pickup)

luggage.description: Large bags (optional; filters vehicles and prefills the booking form)

pax.description: Passengers 1-16 (filters vehicles; 12-16 returns the two-vehicle Carnival+Maxi combination priced as a total). Groups over 16 return match "none" with contact details - do not quote them a price.

pickup.description: Alias for from (same meaning as request_booking.pickup)

return_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD return pick-up date in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) (optional; implies trip=return)

return_time.description: HH:MM 24h return pick-up time in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) (optional; implies trip=return)

time.description: HH:MM 24h in Queensland time (AEST, no daylight saving) (optional; flags after-hours surcharge)

to.description: Drop-off place, e.g. "Gold Coast Airport", "Brisbane Airport" or a suburb (alias: dropoff)

trip.description: one_way (default) or return. When return, also send return_date and return_time.

name: get_quote

outputSchema.description: The live fixed-price list result, passed through from the booking site. match fixed_route = options carries per-vehicle prices; none / blocked / unavailable = no price, give the customer the contact details or message. If the quote service itself refused (e.g. rate limit) the object carries error instead of match.

title: Get a fixed-price quote
